notes.content: Communication Studies majors must complete a formal minor or a second major in a department outside of Communication Studies. Students must obtain their major advisor's approval on their selection of a minor and courses for the minor. Both departments' approval for courses for the minor is required.

Communication Studies majors must complete a formal minor or a second major in a department outside of Communication Studies.

  • Students must obtain their major advisor's approval on their selection of a minor and courses for the minor.
  • Both departments' approval for courses for the minor is required.
